blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧのレビューをこのページにまとめていきます。
blocks.translation: I will compile reviews of commercially released RPGs on this page.

blocks.source: レビューには、自分の好みを反映しながらも、なるべく明確な基準を持って点を付けているつもりです。ただ、プレイした時期や順番によって、ブレがあるかもしれません。ＦＣ～ＧＢ並に古い作品は今の基準でレビューすると、軒並み点数が低くなってしまうので、あまりレビューしません。
blocks.translation: While reflecting my personal preferences, I try to assign scores based on standards that are as clear as possible. However, there may be some inconsistencies depending on when and in what order I played the games. I do not review many games as old as those from the FC to GB era, because scoring them by today's standards would make their scores uniformly low.

blocks.source: 過去の作品は記憶を元にレビューしていたりするので、細かいところで間違いがあるかもしれません。その辺はご容赦ください。
blocks.translation: Since some reviews of older games are based on my memories, there may be minor inaccuracies. I hope you will forgive me for those.

I do not review many games as old as those from the FC to GB era, because scoring them by today's standards would make their scores uniformly low.
texts.過去の作品は記憶を元にレビューしていたりするので、細かいところで間違いがあるかも: Since some reviews of older games are based on my memories, there may be minor inaccuracies. I hope you will forgive me for those.
